title: The Hunter's Tale
text: An old hunter sits at a waystation fire, one arm gone at the elbow, a necklace of claws at his throat. He has hunted this very quarry, he says, and lost, and he lost more than his arm. He will tell you how, for a drink.

options.label: Buy the old hunter his drink.

outcomes.text: He tells you where it hides, and what it fears, and what it did to his arm.

options.label: The most seasoned trades stories with him.

outcomes.text: He tells them the trick he never got to use, and grips their wrist hard as he does.

options.label: Scoff at him, and go on.

outcomes.text: He calls after you exactly how he lost, in detail, and you cannot stop hearing it.
